serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Mrs. Fisher: So you're saying that you gained some experience, huh.
You: Yes, I caught more than a dozen fish now.
Mrs. Fisher: Not bad for a greenhorn like you.
Mrs. Fisher: If you are interested, I can tell you about other ways you can fish.
You: Other ways?
Mrs. Fisher: Most of the hobbyists use the fishing rod. Battling with a fish, sometimes for hours, gives by far the most satisfaction, but there are other ways.
You: Like what?
Mrs. Fisher: Some catch them with spears, others with various traps, commercial fishers usually use nets and there are also people who catch them with bare hands.
You: Bare hands?! How is that possible?!
#mrsfisher.face.angry
Mrs. Fisher: {{punch}}Don’t raise your voice, kid! You will scare all the fish away!
You: S-Sorry…
#mrsfisher.face.normal
Mrs. Fisher: There are many techniques to catch a fish bare handed. The most popular and the easiest is to stand still in shallow water and wait for the right moment to strike. It’s similar to spear fishing, but the spear greatly increases the range.
You: Yeah, I think I will stick to the fishing rod. It’s cold and standing in freezing water isn’t for me.
Mrs. Fisher: Suit yourself.
